messages:
sara_finance: Heads up — GCP Marketplace invoice shows a NEGATIVE line for reseller commission on invoice `GCP-INV-2026-03-0123`. Delta: -$12,345. No refund was requested on our side. Can someone check?

mike_accounts: Which customer/account is this for? Any linked credits?

sara_finance: Customer = Acme Corp (tenant: acme-prod). Line item label: `reseller_commission_adjustment`. Date on invoice: 2026-03-01. We checked usage logs, nothing shows a reversal.

olivia_sales: cc @raj_partner_ops — did the channel partner issue a retro credit?

raj_partner_ops: Not from our end. We haven't processed any refunds for Acme this cycle. I can ping the partner rep but wondering if this could be a marketplace-side settlement correction.

gcp-billing-bot: System notice: GCP Marketplace settled adjustment detected for invoice GCP-INV-2026-03-0123, amount -12345 USD. Reference ID: MKT-SETTLE-67890.

mike_accounts: Can you paste the raw line item export? I want to reconcile account usage vs invoice.

sara_finance: Pasting CSV snippet below: ```invoice_id,customer,product,description,amount,currency
GCP-INV-2026-03-0123,acme-prod,redwood-inference, reseller_commission_adjustment,-12345,USD```

mike_accounts: Ok thanks. I ran a quick query against our usage ledger and got no matching negative entries. Running full reconciliation now (`SELECT * FROM billing_usage WHERE tenant='acme-prod' AND date >= '2026-02-01'`). Will update.

raj_partner_ops: I'm emailing the partner finance contact now. Will ask for their settlement report and whether they pushed any off-cycle credits to Marketplace.

olivia_sales: @sara_finance can we hold accounting action until partner confirms? We should avoid sending a reversal if Marketplace already issued credit upstream.

sara_finance: Agreed. But need to flag revenue recognition impact for March close. I'll create a ticket: FIN-2026-184 to track the root cause and any ASC adjustments.

gcp-billing-bot: Note: If partner-initiated credit, Marketplace may claim the refund and adjust payouts. Check Marketplace settlement center: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/settlement (link)

mike_accounts: Reconciliation done — no matching negative on our internal ledger. Filing an internal hold for the invoice in NetSuite, tagging `hold:investigate`.

raj_partner_ops: Partner replied: they see an internal adjustment but it was meant for a different reseller account (routing error). They're escalating to GCP support. They've shared ticket GCP-TKT-33421.

sara_finance: Good find. Please add the partner's settlement PDF to FIN-2026-184.

olivia_sales: If this is a routing error, we may need a credit-back from Marketplace or partner. Keep me posted, we might need to re-invoice.

mike_accounts: I'll hold posting the credit memo until we have formal confirmation from GCP support.

sara_finance: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: 1) raj — update when partner/GCP responds; 2) mike — keep invoice on hold; 3) olivia — flag Acme account for Communications if we need to re-bill.

raj_partner_ops: Will do. Updating the ticket now with partner escalation ref.

mike_accounts: Logged NetSuite hold and added comment with partner ticket GCP-TKT-33421.

sara_finance: Closing loop for today — will post to FIN weekly sync if anything changes. :thumbsup:
